fullDescription: A premium, polished dark-mode aesthetic featuring editorial typography and liquid glassmorphism. This design system is built for high-end creative agencies, luxury services, and boutique brands that value elegance and minimalism. Key features include a sophisticated black-on-black color palette, Instrument Serif headers, staggered text layouts, and high-performance micro-interactions like scale-overshoot hover effects and scroll-triggered reveals.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-end editorial dark-mode design system with a focus on 'Instrument Serif' typography, sophisticated black gradients, and glassmorphic UI components. It uses a hierarchy of white text opacities (40-90%) against deep black backgrounds to create depth without vibrant colors.

## Estilo Visual
Create a premium dark-themed UI using a palette of pure black (#000000) and off-blacks (#050505, #080808). Typography: Use 'Instrument Serif' for primary headings (64px to 160px) and navigation links (20px to 24px); use 'Inter' for body copy (14px to 16px) and utility text. Text colors should range from full white to white/20% opacity. UI elements should feature 'Liquid Glass' styling: background color rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01), backdrop-filter: blur(8px), and a border of 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). All interactive elements must use cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for transitions.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Navigation
Design a fixed header with a gradient background from black/90% to transparent. Padding: py-10 px-24. Links should be 'Instrument Serif' font-semibold, text-xl, color white/60%. Add a 1px border-b border-white/10. Include a max-width container of 1280px with a gap of 112px between nav items.

### Staggered Hero Section
Construct a full-height hero section with a video background and a black/40% overlay. On the left, place four stacked lines of 'Instrument Serif' text with increasing indentation: Line 1 (0px), Line 2 (64px), Line 3 (128px), Line 4 (192px). Font sizes should decrease slightly per line (10rem down to 7rem). On the right, place a text shuffler and a large 'Liquid Glass' rounded-full button.

### Service Grids
Implement content sections using a 4-column grid (desktop) and 1-column (mobile). Each card should be a 'Liquid Glass' container with rounded-3xl corners (24px) and 32px padding. Use Lucide-style icons with 40% opacity that transition to 80% on hover.

### Split Feature Section
A 2-column layout for detailed services. Left column: Large serif header, body text at 60% opacity, and a bulleted list with white/40% dots. Right column: A large square 'Liquid Glass' container with an inner gradient container holding a centered iconic graphic.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Premium Nav Link — A high-interaction navigation element with scale and glow.
Style links with 'Instrument Serif'. On hover: 1. Scale to 1.25x. 2. Change color from white/60% to 100% white. 3. Apply drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)). 4. Animate a 1.5px thick underline to grow from 0% to 80% width from the center. Duration: 400ms. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1).

### Liquid Glass Card — Sophisticated container with depth and blur.
Apply background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Use rounded corners (minimum 24px).

### Hero Text Shuffler — Animated text rotating through various taglines.
Create an italic 'Instrument Serif' text element that transitions its content every 3500ms. Use a 700ms opacity fade out/in for the transition effect.

style.description: The style is characterized by its 'Liquid Glass' effect (low opacity white with heavy backdrop blur), deep black surfaces (#000000, #050505, #080808), and a pairing of the elegant 'Instrument Serif' with the functional 'Inter' sans-serif. Motion is fluid, using an overshoot cubic-bezier for navigation and gentle fade-ups for content sections.
